Does these two dream are inter-related? Your guidance is highly appreciated. 1598 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, I am sorry this is very complicated. I do not know whether this is a dream or something else, but something very weird happened to me this morning. After Salat Al Fajr, I went to bed and started thinking about death and motherhood (I am not married)- I then just said the sleeping du'a and kalimah and closed my eyes. I don't know whether I was sleeping or not, but I had a "dream" where I remember having a flashback of being in the hospital with a baby, then there was a photocopier and all of the sudden I had to make 4 copies on A4, the copies came out on A3 and the copier was making a noise as if though it was damaged. When I tried to stop the copier, it was like I had gone into some kind of wajd, I couldn't touch the photocopier and my body felt a little paralysed- it was like I was underwater, but I was not, I was in this dreamy life; soon I started descending, almost floating and this was the weird thing- I was going down, floating down. Then I remember thinking that it maybe revelation, but then thought it must be death, so I whispered half the kalimah and all of the sudden my eyes opened- I was in my bed in the position I was floating down in; I then tried moving and Al hamdu lillah I moved and found that I was on my right side perfectly fine. I looked at the time and found that it was only 20 minutes after I had come to sleep. I was scared because I did not know whether I was asleep or not, or whether I was awake because I did not feel sleepy and Allahu 'alam. I have had the experience of sleep paralysis due to jinns, but this was different. I am very sorry for the detail. Jazak Allahu khair. 3626 views Q. Sunnah: Moving to new house 6124 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 43248 Country: India Title: Istikhara Question: I had doubt about a guy whether will get married to him or not. So did istikharah namaz I got a dream in two parts where in first part I got a dream where I tear a white paper into pieces and put it down, and second part of my dream was I saw some dead bodies on them white cloth. So I am scared about this could you please tell me about this. I want to know is this dream positive result or negative result? Answer ID: 43248 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 135/135/M=1434) Your dream is negative. It is better to leave the selection of the groom to your parents and your family members. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
